title: Butter bean, chorizo and paprika stew
preamble:
Make it vegey by missing out the chorizo....I feel I've overstepped the line by typing something so effing obvious!!!!!

150g chorizo

1 garlic clove, chopped

2 teaspoons Rosemary, finely chopped

1.5 teaspoon sweet or hot smoked paprika
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoon sweet or hot smoked paprika
6 thick slices of hot buttered toast
method: Add garlic, Rosemary, paprika and fry for another minute
Add chorizo and warm through and serve over toast
